source.description: A massive shaggy white yeti with slate-blue face and long clawed arms, hunched and breathing heavily, shoulders rising and falling, fur swaying, occasionally flexing its claws. Seamless loop.

The massive white yeti with long clawed arms attacks — it rears up beating its chest once, then swings both clawed arms down toward the camera in a crushing double blow, then drops back into its hunched posture.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
